item.title: By: Eric Peerless
item.dc:creator: Eric Peerless
item.description:
Have you seen any issues with accessibility keys and dotnetnuke? We’ve managed to get the access keys working for every browser but IE 7.

Any thoughts?

item.title: By: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description: Related reading: Browser zoom comparison by Alistair C

item.title: By: Thomas Watson Steen
item.dc:creator: Thomas Watson Steen
item.description:
Sad to say that I do not own a Mac (Jacob, are you reading this?) – so I haven’t tried out Safari. Also nice to hear Opera has been leading the team on this one.

When I showed this to a colleague he said “Wonder who they stole that from”. Now we know :)

item.title: By: sasaeh
item.dc:creator: sasaeh
item.description:
I agree with Jesper.
I was quite amazed when I first saw it in Opera and that’s something I miss in Firefox (2.0 doesn’t come with it either) so, I’m pleased with that feature in IE7.
It doesn’t mean that I will browse with IE7 of course! It’s still far from opera or Firefox.

item.title: By: Jesper Laursen
item.dc:creator: Jesper Laursen
item.description: That feature has been in Opera for loooong time. Beside that does Mac OS X have a feature where you can zoom in where the mouse is, and the zoom is followed when you move the mouse.
